name: ember-nova
description: Ember Nova - comet trails fusing into a nova and particle shockwave (Remotion + Three.js, 4K comps)

scripts.render:1080p: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
scripts.render:4k: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run render:v2:4k
scripts.downscale:v1: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/EmberNova-V1_4K.mp4 -vf zscale=w=1920:h=1080:filter=lanczos:dither=error_diffusion -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -an -movflags +faststart out/EmberNova-V1_1080p.mp4
scripts.downscale:v2: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/EmberNova-V2_4K.mp4 -vf zscale=w=1920:h=1080:filter=lanczos:dither=error_diffusion -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -an -movflags +faststart out/EmberNova-V2_1080p.mp4
scripts.master:v1: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run downscale:v1
scripts.master:v2: npm run render:v2:4k && npm run downscale:v2
scripts.master: npm run master:v1 && npm run master:v2
